records.name: COSMIC SANDS ENCOUNTER
records.sourceDescription: An astronaut walking across moonlit dunes triggers the emergence of glowing alien structures and a massive hovering spacecraft.
records.prompt:
Create a breathtaking 15-second cinematic science fiction sequence titled "THE AWAKENING".
SCENE:
In the year 2189, a lone futuristic astronaut walks across an endless Egyptian desert at midnight. A mysterious blue light begins glowing beneath the golden sand.
0–4 SECONDS:
An ultra-wide aerial cinematic shot reveals the tiny astronaut walking through an enormous moonlit desert. The camera slowly descends toward him as mysterious blue particles float through the air.
4–8 SECONDS:
The astronaut discovers a gigantic ancient alien structure partially buried beneath the sand. He slowly reaches out and touches its glowing surface. Suddenly, powerful blue energy pulses spread across the desert.
8–12 SECONDS:
The ground violently trembles. Massive alien structures rise from beneath the desert, revealing an impossibly enormous extraterrestrial spacecraft hidden for thousands of years. Sand storms swirl around it as brilliant energy beams illuminate the sky.
12–15 SECONDS:
The camera rapidly pulls back into an epic extreme-wide shot as the spacecraft activates, revealing a breathtaking cosmic portal opening above the desert. The astronaut stands motionless, realizing humanity has just discovered something beyond imagination.
VISUAL STYLE:
Hollywood blockbuster cinematography, photorealistic CGI, IMAX quality, Unreal Engine 5 visuals, extraordinary environmental detail, volumetric lighting, realistic sand physics, atmospheric depth, dramatic contrast, sophisticated science fiction production design.
CAMERA:
Professional cinematic camera movement, smooth aerial tracking, dramatic push-ins, dynamic perspective shifts, seamless transitions, epic final reveal.
LIGHTING:
Deep midnight blue, glowing electric cyan, subtle warm golden desert reflections, realistic shadows, volumetric light rays.
AUDIO:
Deep cinematic atmospheric sound design, distant alien humming, powerful sub-bass impacts, rising orchestral tension, massive cinematic sound explosion at the final reveal.
IMPORTANT:
Maintain consistent astronaut appearance, realistic proportions, coherent environments, physically believable movement, no cartoon aesthetics, no text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermarks.
